about_the_game:
Challenge the Wyld Land!

What will you risk to rise to greatness in this cursed world?

Wyld Land is a fast-paced, 2D bullet-hell roguelite MMO where you explore a dangerous world corrupted by ancient technology. Dodge waves of bullets, collect powerful gear, explore ever-changing dungeons, and uncover the mysteries of a fallen civilization.



Defeat foes, earn loot. Delve into dungeons and slay bosses for a chance at rare loot. Customize your build through equipment choices and Spikes - enhancements found throughout the game world. Mix and match weapons, armor, and spikes to create your perfect loadout. Earn higher tier equipment to challenge more difficult enemies and discover even greater strength.

Play with others in an MMO world, combining might, gear, and experience to defeat the corrupted remnants. The world is shared, and danger lurks around every corner. Embark with friends or team-up with others you meet in-game.



Find dungeons by defeating enemies in the overworld. Delve inside and conquer powerful bosses to gain uniquely powerful equipment. Once you're strong enough, Corrupted Dungeons take the challenge even further with modifiers that change the experience and even tougher versions of bosses you previously faced.

Features

  • Echoes: Death means losing all your gear - but some abilities, known as Echoes, persist through death. Build your power gradually while risking it all on each run.

  • Constant Evolution: Regular updates bring new content, challenges, and mysteries to uncover. We plan to release Seasons on a regular basis which will shake up the meta of the game, introduce new weapons and gear, and provide new challenging bosses.

  • Dynamic Multiplayer: Team up with other Runners or go it solo seeking rare loot. Your actions affect and are affected by other players in real-time.

  • Ever-Changing Dungeons: Dungeons in Wyld Land are procedurally generated, so you'll never see the same one twice. For the truly brave, pop corrupted shards and take on difficult mutations as the difficulty scales up even further -- but the rewards get better, too.

  • Character Customization: Customize your build through equipment choices and Spikes - enhancements found throughout the game world. Mix and match weapons, armor, and spikes to create your perfect loadout.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3330 or AMD A10 5700
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 7750 (1GB VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
